name: Udaan Rubik's Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Sardar Patel Institute of Technology
venue.address: Sardar Patel Institute of Technology, Bhavan's Campus, Munshi Nagar, Andheri (West), Mumbai - 400058

information:
**New Participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UdaanRubiksCubeOpen2018#3110-registration-payment) tab. 
**Returning participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions.
Step 2 - Register for the competition.
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UdaanRubiksCubeOpen2018#3110-registration-payment) tab.
*Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.*
**For more details on the registration process please check the[ registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UdaanRubiksCubeOpen2018#3110-registration-payment) tab.
For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UdaanRubiksCubeOpen2018#3111-schedule) tab.**
